evidence.r1: Glass belongs to compare, rating and adjustment controls; side metadata and filmstrip use solid grounds in both schemes.
evidence.r2: Expanded crop controls use flat inset fills within one continuous material in both schemes.
evidence.r3: Three material groups provide comparison, tools and culling without decorative glass in both schemes.
evidence.r4: Compare, rating and crop controls share the same frosted material appearance in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear variant is visible; crop tool is frosted over the photograph in both schemes.
evidence.r6: Compare selection and crop selection are neutral fills without coloured action tints in both schemes.
evidence.r7: Light tool surface carries distinct orange glove and blue trouser colours through the material.
evidence.r8: Compare and rating bars are capsules, crop popup and small fields are rounded rectangles in both schemes.
evidence.r9: Crop fields have smaller corner radii inside the larger popup, with visually comfortable insets in both schemes.
evidence.r10: Compact Reset and Done controls use small rounded rectangles within the floating crop tool in both schemes.
evidence.r11: Comparison, culling and adjustments each share their own control background in both schemes.
evidence.r12: Crop popup text controls Reset and Done share material with the right-hand icon tool buttons in both schemes.
evidence.r13: One crop material covers the whole adjustment control group rather than each slider individually in both schemes.
evidence.r14: Expanded crop tools merge with their icon rail as a single continuous rounded surface in both schemes.
evidence.r15: No scroll-edge treatment is shown near the floating image controls or filmstrip in either scheme.
evidence.r16: All glass surfaces lie over varied photographic content in both schemes.
evidence.r17: Rating bar covers the photographed anvil and compare covers the worker’s arm at rest in both schemes.
evidence.r18: Small crop labels sit over variable brown and blue material; required numeric contrast is not established in both schemes.
evidence.r19: Light reduced controls stay visible, but increased contrast and reduced motion are not captured.
evidence.r20: Main photograph is inset between solid side columns with hard edges in both schemes.
evidence.r21: Both side columns terminate the photograph at hard vertical edges without background extension in both schemes.
evidence.r22: Floating compare, rating and crop surfaces have no separate custom backing panel in either scheme.
evidence.r23: Crop endpoint stills cannot establish material morphing or pointer-local press feedback in either scheme.
evidence.r24: Compare, crop and rating control content is monochrome in both schemes.
evidence.r25: Control labels avoid the orange and blue photographic hues beneath them in both schemes.
